import json

OUT = Path('/app/output')

def connect():

    print(json.dumps(r.spec(), indent=2))

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
SPEC = json.loads((OUT/'spec.json').read_text())
AXES = np.array(SPEC['arm']['axis'])
PIVOTS = np.array(SPEC['arm']['position_m'])
EEF = np.array(SPEC['arm']['end_effector']['position_m'])

def fk(q, point=EEF):
    R = np.eye(3); t = np.zeros(3)
    for a,p,theta in zip(AXES,PIVOTS,q):
        Q = Rotation.from_rotvec(a*theta).as_matrix()
        t += R @ (p-Q@p)
        R = R@Q
    return R@point+t, R

def cam_pose(proprio):
    b=np.array(proprio[:3]); q=proprio[6:13]
    cp=SPEC['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']
    p,R=fk(q,np.array(cp['position_m']))
    B=Rotation.from_euler('z',b[2]).as_matrix()
    return B@p+np.r_[b[:2],0], B@R@np.array([cp['right'],cp['up'],cp['forward']]).T

def ik(pos, rot, q0, reg=0.002):
    lower=np.array([-20,-2.24,-20,-2.57,-20,-2.09,-20]); upper=np.array([20,2.24,20,2.57,20,2.09,20])
    def fun(q):
        p,R=fk(q)
        return np.r_[(p-pos)*4, Rotation.from_matrix(rot@R.T).as_rotvec(), (q-q0)*reg]
    sol=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q0,lower+1e-6,upper-1e-6),bounds=(lower,upper),max_nfev=500)
    return sol.x, np.linalg.norm(fk(sol.x)[0]-pos)

def state(r):
    return np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'])

def joints(r,q, label, grip=0, max_steps=100, tol=.008, rate=.08):
    for i in range(max_steps):
        s=state(r); d=q-s[6:13]
        if np.max(abs(d))<tol:break
        a=np.r_[np.zeros(3),np.clip(d,-rate,rate),grip]
        res=command(r,a,f'{label}_{i:03}')
        if res.done:break
    return observe(r,label)

def cart(r,pos,rot,label,grip=0,rate=.06,max_steps=100):
    s=state(r); q,err=ik(np.array(pos),rot,s[6:13])
    print('IK',q,'error',err)
    if err>.01:raise RuntimeError('Unreachable target')
    return joints(r,q,label,grip,max_steps,rate=rate)

def cloud(label):
    s=json.loads((OUT/label/'meta.json').read_text())['proprio']['now']
    dep=np.load(OUT/label/'depth_robot_wrist.npy')[-1].astype(float)
    p,R=cam_pose(s)
    h,w=dep.shape; f=h/(2*np.tan(np.deg2rad(SPEC['cameras']['robot_wrist']['fovy_deg'])/2))
    u,v=np.meshgrid(np.arange(w),np.arange(h))
    local=np.stack([(u-(w-1)/2)/f, -(v-(h-1)/2)/f,np.ones_like(u)],axis=-1)*dep[:,:,None]
    return local@R.T+p

def world_cart(r,pos,rot,label,grip=0,rate=.1,max_steps=100):
    s=state(r);B=Rotation.from_euler('z',s[2]).as_matrix()
    return cart(r,B.T@(np.array(pos)-np.r_[s[:2],0]),B.T@rot,label,grip,rate,max_steps)

def linear(r,pos,rot,label,grip=1,speed=.012,max_steps=60):
    target=np.array(pos); history=[]
    for i in range(max_steps):
        s=state(r);B=Rotation.from_euler('z',s[2]).as_matrix();p0,R0=fk(s[6:13]);p=B@p0+np.r_[s[:2],0]
        d=target-p; angle=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@(B@R0).T).magnitude()
        if np.linalg.norm(d)<.002 and angle<.012:break
        d*=min(1,speed/max(np.linalg.norm(d),1e-8))
        qp,err=ik(B.T@(p+d-np.r_[s[:2],0]),B.T@rot,s[6:13],reg=.0002)
        if err>.008: print('unreachable',err);break
        res=command(r,np.r_[np.zeros(3),np.clip(2.5*(qp-s[6:13]),-.1,.1),grip],f'{label}_{i:03}')
        history.append(p)
        if len(history)>7 and np.linalg.norm(p-history[-7])<.001 and np.linalg.norm(target-p)>.008: print('stalled',p);break
        if res.done:break
    return observe(r,label)
